title: report rockets amen thompson reach 5 year 208m extension  flm 2026 09 03
text:
Sep 03 (Field Level Media) - Houston Rockets guard Amen Thompson has agreed to a five-year, $208 ​million rookie-scale contract extension, ESPN ‌reported Thursday morning.
Per the report, Thompson's deal includes a 10% trade ​kicker.
Thompson, 23, is entering the ​final season of a four-year ⁠rookie contract he signed in ​2023. He will earn $12.26 million ​this season, per Spotrac, before his new deal starts in the summer of ​2027.
Once Thompson signs, the Rockets ​will have locked up their young core ‌of ⁠Thompson, Alperen Sengun, Jabari Smith Jr. and Tari Eason to multi-year contracts.
Thompson led the NBA ​in minutes ​played (2,953) ⁠last season while averaging career highs in points (18.3), ​assists (5.3) and steals (1.5).
He has ​averaged ⁠14.3 points and 7.6 rebounds in 210 career games (144 starts) since ⁠being ​selected by the ​Rockets with the fourth overall pick of ​the 2023 NBA Draft.
--Field Level Media
